dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: First ex-dividend date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty to start from today.

dateTo.title: To date
dateTo.description: Last ex-dividend date to include, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave empty for 30 days after the start date. The range is capped at 90 days.

tickers.title: Ticker watchlist
tickers.description: Only return these symbols. Leave empty to get every company with a dividend in the date range.

minDividendRate.title: Minimum dividend rate
minDividendRate.description: Skip dividends below this cash amount per share, for example 0.50. Rows where Nasdaq reports no rate are skipped when this is set. Leave empty for no filter.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new dividends only
newOnly.description: Remember dividends already returned and emit only ones not seen before. Run this on a daily schedule for a clean feed of newly announced dividends. Quiet runs cost nothing.
